products.name: Krea AI
products.note: Real-time video generation; creative tool; content moderation; emerging platform

profile_text.body:
Krea is a creative AI software company whose platform, Krea AI, is described on its site as a suite for generating, editing, and enhancing images, videos, and 3D assets. The company positions its product as accessible to individual creators and teams, offering a free starting tier alongside collaborative workflows.

On the video side, the platform aggregates several third-party generation models, including Veo 3, Kling, Hailuo, Wan, Sora 2, and Runway, and the company describes its interface as the world's most intuitive AI video generation tool. For image editing, Krea offers a choice of ten models, among them Nano Banana, Flux Kontext, and Qwen, covering tasks such as object removal, expression changes, and lighting adjustments. Users can also train custom models by uploading a small set of images tied to a face, product, or visual style, and a Slack integration brings the same generative tools into team conversations.

The held facts note Krea AI is tracked as a video generation and editing product with real-time capabilities and content moderation features. No litigation, SEC filings, patents, or MCP server registrations are recorded for the company at this time.
